messages:
Lia Chen: Thinking aloud — can we attach routing + quota hints and a tiny telemetry sample rate to saved views so Console can show cost/latency previews before a user runs a query?
Mike O'Neill: yes please. UX needs an unobtrusive badge, maybe an info tooltip with estimates.
Anna Patel: important: these hints are advisory only. backend routing still decides by policy. we shouldn't let saved views override tenant-level SLAs.
Josh Rivera: Agreed. Implementation idea: annotations on the saved_view object, not separate resource. keep it optional.
Samir Gupta: +1. Also we need an internal header so the runtime can prefer variants: `X-Redwood-Route-Hint: low-latency` (internal only).
Lia Chen: Proto for saved view (very rough):
```
POST /api/v1/saved_views
{
  "name": "Recent errors (model-aware)",
  "filters": [...],
  "annotations": {
    "route_hint": "low-latency",    // values: low-latency | cost-optimized | regional-preferred
    "quota_hint": "preview",        // preview | heavy | interactive
    "telemetry_sample": 0.02         // fraction used for extra telemetry/quality checks
  }
}
```
Mike O'Neill: That looks good. telemetry_sample needs guardrails — we can't flip to 1.0 by mistake. default 0.01? limit 0.1 for saved views.
Anna Patel: Also consider a UI toggle: "Show cost/latency estimates" per workspace, opt-out for privacy.
Josh Rivera: For rollout: feature flag in console + gradual rollout to 10% of orgs. backend respects annotations only if org flag enabled.
Samir Gupta: Ops concern: if many saved views ask for high-sample telemetry we could spike ingestion. need quota enforcement and a circuit breaker.
Lia Chen: Action items: 1) Anna to write UI mockups and tooltip wording. 2) Josh to spec API validation + guardrails. 3) Samir to propose quota circuit breaker thresholds. 4) Mike to own rollout flag and telemetry metrics for the experiment.
console-bot: Deploy checklist created — /infra/tasks/RED-4521 (assigned Mike).
Mike O'Neill: I'll prototype API + console badge this week. ping me for UX reviews. :thumbsup:
Anna Patel: I'll drop initial mockups in #design by EOD tomorrow.
Lia Chen: thanks team. small follow-up: add `annotations.metadata.source = "console.saved_view"` so downstream can filter telemetry from saved views vs ad-hoc runs.
Samir Gupta: good call. that'll help investigate spikes.
Lia Chen: OK closing thread, we'll sync in next product triage.
